_note: Main work-authorisation routes for skilled non-EU foreign nationals, compiled from official government pages (checked via web fetch on the compile date). Each figure carries its source and asOf month. Thresholds change (often annually); re-verify before each release. Items that could not be verified on an official page were omitted.

disclaimer.ja: 本情報は一般的な情報提供を目的としたものであり、法的助言ではありません。制度・金額は頻繁に改定されるため、申請前に必ず各国政府の公式情報を確認し、必要に応じて専門家にご相談ください。
disclaimer.en: This is general information, not legal advice. Rules and figures change frequently; always check the official government sources (and consult a qualified adviser if needed) before making decisions or applying.

name.ja: 技術・人文知識・国際業務
name.en: Engineer / Specialist in Humanities / International Services

summary.ja: 日本の企業等との契約に基づき、技術者・通訳・デザイナー・語学教師・マーケティング等の専門業務に従事するための就労在留資格。
summary.en: The standard work status for professional roles such as engineers, interpreters, designers, private-sector language teachers and marketing staff, based on a contract with an organisation in Japan.

requirements.ja: 日本の機関との雇用契約等
requirements.en: Contract with an employer/organisation in Japan

requirements.ja: 関連分野の大学卒業（または日本の専修学校専門課程修了）、または関連業務の実務経験
requirements.en: Relevant university degree (or Japanese vocational college diploma), or relevant work experience

requirements.ja: 日本人と同等額以上の報酬
requirements.en: Pay at least equal to that of a Japanese national in the same role

processingNote.ja: 在留期間は5年・3年・1年・3か月。提出書類は所属機関の規模に応じたカテゴリー1〜4で異なる。
processingNote.en: Periods of stay: 5 years, 3 years, 1 year or 3 months. Required documents depend on the employer's category (1–4, by company size).

source.title: 出入国在留管理庁「技術・人文知識・国際業務」

name.ja: 高度専門職（高度人材ポイント制）

summary.ja: 学歴・職歴・年収等のポイント合計が70点以上の高度外国人材に、在留期間5年や永住許可要件の緩和などの優遇措置を与える在留資格。
summary.en: For highly skilled foreign professionals scoring 70+ points on education, experience, salary and other factors; grants preferential treatment such as a 5-year stay and a faster route to permanent residence.

requirements.ja: ポイント合計70点以上（学術研究・専門技術・経営管理の3類型）
requirements.en: At least 70 points (academic research, specialised/technical, or business management activity)

requirements.ja: 日本の機関との契約等
requirements.en: Contract with an organisation in Japan

requirements.ja: 高度専門職1号ロ・ハは年収300万円以上が必須
requirements.en: Categories 1(b) and 1(c) require annual income of at least JPY 3 million

salaryThreshold.note: Minimum floor for categories 1(b) specialised/technical and 1(c) business management; below this the applicant is not recognised even with 70+ points. Salary also earns points on a sliding scale.

processingNote.ja: 1号で3年以上活動すると、在留期間無期限の2号へ移行可能。
processingNote.en: After 3+ years in category 1, holders can move to category 2 with an unlimited period of stay.

source.title: 出入国在留管理庁「高度人材ポイント制Q&A」（令和8年4月時点）

name.ja: H-1B（専門職）

summary.ja: 学士以上の専門知識を要する職種で米国雇用主に雇用されるための就労ビザ。年間上限があり、電子登録からの選考は2026年2月27日以降、賃金水準で重み付けされる。
summary.en: Employer-sponsored visa for jobs requiring at least a bachelor's degree in a specific specialty. It is subject to an annual cap, and since 27 Feb 2026 registrations are selected by a wage-level-weighted process that replaces the random lottery.

requirements.ja: 米国雇用主のスポンサー（電子登録で選ばれる必要あり）
requirements.en: U.S. employer sponsor; cap-subject petitions require a selected registration

requirements.ja: 職務関連分野の学士以上の学位（または同等）
requirements.en: Bachelor's or higher degree (or equivalent) in a directly related specialty

requirements.ja: 実際賃金またはプリベイリング・ウェイジの高い方以上の支払い（LCA）
requirements.en: Pay at least the actual or prevailing wage, whichever is higher (Labor Condition Application)

requirements.ja: 年間上限65,000件＋米国修士以上20,000件（大学等は上限対象外）
requirements.en: Annual cap of 65,000 plus 20,000 for U.S. master's or higher; universities, affiliated nonprofits and government research organisations are cap-exempt

processingNote.ja: 2025年9月21日の大統領布告により、有効なH-1Bビザを持たない米国外の受益者の一部申請に10万ドルの支払いが必要。
processingNote.en: Under a Presidential Proclamation effective 21 Sep 2025, certain petitions for beneficiaries outside the U.S. without a valid H-1B visa require a USD 100,000 payment.

source.title: USCIS – H-1B Specialty Occupations

name.ja: L-1（企業内転勤）

summary.ja: 海外の関連会社で直近3年以内に継続1年以上勤務した管理職・役員（L-1A）や専門知識を持つ社員（L-1B）が、米国の同一・関連企業へ転勤するためのビザ。
summary.en: For managers or executives (L-1A) and specialised-knowledge staff (L-1B) who transfer to a related U.S. entity after at least one continuous year with the company abroad within the last three years.

requirements.ja: 海外の関連会社で直近3年内に継続1年以上の勤務
requirements.en: One continuous year of employment with a qualifying organisation abroad within the prior three years

requirements.ja: 米国企業と海外企業の資格ある関係（親子・関連会社等）
requirements.en: Qualifying relationship between the U.S. and foreign employers

requirements.ja: 管理職・役員（L-1A）または専門知識職（L-1B）
requirements.en: Executive/managerial role (L-1A) or specialised knowledge (L-1B)

processingNote.ja: L-1Aは当初最長3年（新規事務所は1年）、延長は2年単位で最長7年。
processingNote.en: L-1A: initial stay up to 3 years (1 year for a new office), extendable in 2-year increments to a maximum of 7 years.

source.title: USCIS – L-1A Intracompany Transferee Executive or Manager

name.ja: O-1（卓越能力者）

summary.ja: 科学・教育・ビジネス・スポーツ（O-1A）や芸術・映画テレビ（O-1B）で卓越した能力を持つ人のためのビザ。年間上限なし。
summary.en: For people with extraordinary ability in the sciences, education, business or athletics (O-1A), or in the arts and film/TV (O-1B). There is no annual cap.

requirements.ja: 米国の雇用主またはエージェントによる申請
requirements.en: Petition filed by a U.S. employer or agent

requirements.ja: 規定の証拠類型のうち3つ以上で卓越性を立証
requirements.en: Evidence meeting at least three of the regulatory criteria

requirements.ja: 同業団体等による諮問意見書
requirements.en: Written advisory opinion (consultation) from a peer group or expert

processingNote.ja: 当初最長3年、1年単位で延長可。
processingNote.en: Initial stay up to 3 years, extendable in 1-year increments.

source.title: USCIS – O-1 Visa: Individuals with Extraordinary Ability or Achievement

name.ja: EB-2 NIW（国益免除・永住権）

summary.ja: 修士以上（または学士＋5年の経験）や卓越能力を持つ人向けの永住権カテゴリーで、国益免除（NIW）が認められれば雇用主・労働認定なしに自己申請できる。
summary.en: A green-card category for advanced-degree holders (or those with exceptional ability). With a National Interest Waiver, applicants can self-petition without an employer or labor certification.

requirements.ja: 修士以上、または学士＋5年の段階的実務経験、または卓越能力（6基準中3つ）
requirements.en: Master's or higher, bachelor's plus 5 years' progressive experience, or exceptional ability (3 of 6 criteria)

requirements.ja: 提案する事業が相当のメリットと国家的重要性を持つ
requirements.en: Proposed endeavour has substantial merit and national importance

requirements.ja: 申請者がその事業を推進する立場にある
requirements.en: Applicant is well positioned to advance the endeavour

requirements.ja: 雇用オファー・労働認定を免除することが米国の利益になる
requirements.en: On balance, waiving the job offer and labor certification benefits the U.S.

source.title: USCIS – Employment-Based Immigration: Second Preference EB-2

freeMovement.ja: アイルランド国民は共通旅行区域（CTA）により許可なく英国で居住・就労可能。EU市民の英国への移動の自由は2020年12月31日に終了し、EU定住スキームの資格を持たない場合は他の外国人と同様にビザが必要。
freeMovement.en: Irish citizens can live and work in the UK without permission under the Common Travel Area. Free movement between the UK and the EU ended on 31 Dec 2020, so EU citizens without EU Settlement Scheme status need a visa like other nationals.

name.ja: スキルドワーカービザ

summary.ja: 内務省認定のスポンサー企業からの雇用オファーに基づく就労ビザ。給与は一般基準額と職種ごとの「going rate」の高い方以上が必要。
summary.en: Employer-sponsored visa for a job with a Home Office-approved sponsor. The salary must be at least the higher of the general threshold and the occupation's 'going rate'.

requirements.ja: 認定スポンサーからの雇用オファーとスポンサーシップ証明書（CoS）
requirements.en: Job offer from an approved sponsor with a certificate of sponsorship (CoS)

requirements.ja: 対象職種リストに含まれる職種（中技能職は追加条件あり）
requirements.en: Job on the eligible occupations list; medium-skilled roles have extra conditions

requirements.ja: 年£41,700または職種のgoing rateの高い方以上の給与
requirements.en: Salary of at least £41,700 a year or the occupation's going rate, whichever is higher

requirements.ja: 英語力
requirements.en: English language ability

salaryThreshold.note: General threshold, or the occupation's going rate if higher. It applies to CoS issued on or after 22 Jul 2025. A lower £33,400 floor may apply in some cases (not healthcare/education); see gov.uk 'when you can be paid less'.

source.title: GOV.UK – Skilled Worker visa: your job

name.ja: グローバル・タレントビザ

summary.ja: 学術・研究、芸術・文化、デジタル技術分野のリーダーまたは将来のリーダー向けのビザ。認定機関の推薦（または指定の賞の受賞）が必要。
summary.en: For leaders or potential leaders in academia/research, arts and culture, or digital technology. Requires an endorsement from an endorsing body, or an eligible prestigious prize.

requirements.ja: 18歳以上
requirements.en: Aged 18 or over

requirements.ja: 認定機関からの推薦、または指定の権威ある賞の受賞
requirements.en: Endorsement from an endorsing body, or an eligible prestigious prize

processingNote.ja: 1回最長5年、更新回数に上限なし。申請料£766＋医療付加料。
processingNote.en: Up to 5 years at a time with no limit on renewals. Application fee £766 plus the immigration health surcharge.

source.title: GOV.UK – Global Talent visa

name.ja: エクスプレス・エントリー（永住権）

summary.ja: 連邦熟練労働者・連邦熟練職種・カナダ経験クラスの永住権申請を管理する制度。候補者はCRS（最大1,200点）で順位付けされ、定期的な選抜ラウンドで上位者に申請招待が送られる。
summary.en: Manages permanent-residence applications for the Federal Skilled Worker, Federal Skilled Trades and Canadian Experience Class programs. Candidates are ranked by CRS score (out of 1,200), and the highest-ranked are invited to apply in regular rounds.

requirements.ja: 3つの対象プログラムのいずれかの要件を満たす
requirements.en: Eligibility for one of the three federal programs

requirements.ja: CRSスコアがラウンドの最低点を上回る（技能・学歴・語学・職歴等）
requirements.en: CRS score above the round's cut-off (skills, education, language, work experience, other factors)

requirements.ja: 2025年3月25日以降、雇用オファーはCRS加点対象外
requirements.en: Since 25 Mar 2025, job offers no longer add CRS points

source.title: Canada.ca – Comprehensive Ranking System criteria

name.ja: 雇用主指定就労許可（LMIA）

summary.ja: 特定の雇用主・職種・勤務地で働くための就労許可。多くの場合、雇用主が労働市場影響評価（LMIA）で国内労働者がいないことを示す必要がある。
summary.en: A work permit tied to a specific employer, occupation and location. Most jobs require the employer to obtain a positive Labour Market Impact Assessment (LMIA) showing no Canadian worker is available.

requirements.ja: 不遵守雇用主リストに載っていない雇用主からの雇用オファー
requirements.en: Job offer from an employer not on the non-compliant employers list

requirements.ja: 肯定的LMIA（LMIA免除職種を除く）
requirements.en: Positive LMIA (LMIA letter and Annex A), unless the job is LMIA-exempt

source.title: Canada.ca – Employer-specific work permits

freeMovement.ja: EU加盟国の市民は就労許可なしにドイツで働ける（EU域内の移動の自由）。
freeMovement.en: EU citizens can work in Germany without a work permit under EU free movement.

name.ja: EUブルーカード

summary.ja: 大学卒業者（一部IT専門家は学位不要）が、基準額以上の給与でドイツの雇用主に雇用される場合の滞在許可。
summary.en: Residence permit for university graduates (and some IT specialists without a degree) with a qualifying job offer in Germany that meets the salary threshold.

requirements.ja: ドイツの学位またはそれと同等の外国の学位
requirements.en: German degree or a comparable foreign degree

requirements.ja: 6か月以上の具体的な雇用オファー（学歴に見合う職務）
requirements.en: Concrete job offer of at least six months matching the qualification

requirements.ja: 2026年の年間総給与€50,700以上（不足職種・新卒等は€45,934.20でBA承認要）
requirements.en: 2026 gross salary of at least €50,700/year (€45,934.20 for shortage occupations and new entrants, with Federal Employment Agency approval)

salaryThreshold.note: 2026 standard threshold (gross). Reduced threshold of €45,934.20 for shortage occupations and career starters, and for IT specialists without a degree (3 years' IT experience in the last 7), both requiring Federal Employment Agency approval. Adjusted annually.

source.title: Bundesagentur für Arbeit – Blaue Karte EU (Newsletter 03/2026)

name.ja: 専門人材向け滞在許可（§18a/§18b）

summary.ja: ドイツで認定された職業資格（§18a）または学位（§18b）を持つ人が、資格に合った雇用オファーに基づき就労するための滞在許可。
summary.en: For people with a vocational qualification (§18a) or university degree (§18b) recognised in Germany and a job offer that fits the qualification.

requirements.ja: ドイツで認定された、または同等の学位・職業資格
requirements.en: Recognised or comparable degree or vocational qualification

requirements.ja: 具体的な雇用オファー・雇用契約
requirements.en: Concrete job offer or employment contract

requirements.ja: 連邦雇用庁（BA）の承認
requirements.en: Federal Employment Agency (BA) approval

requirements.ja: 初回申請時45歳以上の場合、公的年金保険の保険料算定上限額の55%以上の給与または十分な老後保障
requirements.en: If aged 45+ at first issue: salary of at least 55% of the statutory pension insurance contribution ceiling, or adequate retirement provision

source.title: BAMF – Fachkräfte mit akademischer Ausbildung

name.ja: オポチュニティカード（Chancenkarte）

summary.ja: ドイツで職探しをするための最長1年の滞在許可。認定資格を持つ専門人材、またはポイント制で6点以上の人が対象で、週20時間までの副業が可能。
summary.en: A job-search residence permit for up to one year, for recognised skilled workers or applicants scoring at least 6 points. Holders may work part-time for up to 20 hours a week.

requirements.ja: 認定済み専門人材、または職業資格（2年以上の職業訓練・学位）＋ポイント6点以上
requirements.en: Recognised skilled worker, or a qualification (2+ years' vocational training or degree) plus at least 6 points

requirements.ja: ドイツ語A1以上または英語B2以上
requirements.en: German at A1 or English at B2 or higher

requirements.ja: 生活費の証明（2026年は月€1,091）
requirements.en: Proof of funds: €1,091 per month (2026)

processingNote.ja: 職探し用カードにBA承認は不要。最長2年の後続カードへ延長可能。試用就労は各2週間まで。
processingNote.en: No BA approval needed for the search card. It can be followed by a follow-up card of up to two years, and trial work of up to two weeks per employer is allowed.

source.title: Bundesagentur für Arbeit – Die Chancenkarte (Newsletter 02/2026)

freeMovement.ja: EU加盟国の市民は就労許可なしにフランスで働ける（EU域内の移動の自由）。
freeMovement.en: EU citizens can work in France without a work permit under EU free movement.

name.ja: タレント – EUブルーカード
name.en: Talent – EU Blue Card (carte bleue européenne)

summary.ja: 高度な資格を持ち、基準額以上の給与でフランスの雇用主に雇用される人向けの複数年滞在許可（「タレント」カードの一類型）。
summary.en: A multi-year 'Talent' residence permit for highly qualified employees of an employer established in France who are paid above the threshold.

requirements.ja: 3年以上の高等教育に相当する学位、または同等レベルの5年の職業経験
requirements.en: Diploma equivalent to at least 3 years of higher education, or 5 years of comparable professional experience

requirements.ja: 無期または6か月以上の有期雇用契約
requirements.en: Permanent contract or fixed-term contract of at least 6 months

requirements.ja: 年間総給与€59,373以上（平均総給与の1.5倍）
requirements.en: Gross salary of at least €59,373/year (1.5 × the average gross reference salary)

salaryThreshold.note: Gross annual salary; 1.5 × the reference salary set annually by decree.

processingNote.ja: 有効期間は雇用契約期間に合わせ最長4年。
processingNote.en: Validity matches the employment contract, up to 4 years.

source.title: Service-Public.fr – Carte talent (F16922)

name.ja: タレント – 資格保有被用者

summary.ja: フランスで修士相当以上の学位を取得した人、革新的企業の研究開発職、グループ内異動者などが対象の「タレント」カード。基準額以上の給与が必要。
summary.en: A 'Talent' permit for holders of a master's-level degree obtained in France, R&D staff at recognised innovative companies, and intra-group transferees who meet the salary floor.

requirements.ja: フランスで取得した修士相当以上の学位（被用者ルート）、または革新的企業・グループ内異動の要件
requirements.en: Master's-level degree obtained in France (qualified-employee track), or innovative-company / intra-group assignment conditions

requirements.ja: 3か月超の雇用契約（被用者ルート）
requirements.en: Employment contract of more than 3 months (qualified-employee track)

requirements.ja: 年間総給与€39,582以上
requirements.en: Gross salary of at least €39,582/year

salaryThreshold.note: Gross annual salary floor for the qualified-employee, innovative-company and employee-on-assignment tracks.

processingNote.ja: 有効期間は雇用契約期間に合わせ最長4年。雇用主の就労許可申請は不要。
processingNote.en: Valid for the contract length, up to 4 years. The employer does not need to request a work authorisation.

source.title: Service-Public.fr – Carte talent (F16922)

freeMovement.ja: EU加盟国の市民は就労許可なしにイタリアで働ける（EU域内の移動の自由）。
freeMovement.en: EU citizens can work in Italy without a work permit under EU free movement.

name.ja: EUブルーカード（Carta Blu UE）

summary.ja: 高度な資格を持つ労働者を、フッシ令の受入枠外で海外から雇用できる制度。
summary.en: Lets Italian employers hire highly qualified workers from abroad outside the Decreto Flussi quotas.

requirements.ja: 3年以上の高等教育学位、レベル6相当の職業資格、または5年以上の職業経験（ITは直近7年で3年）
requirements.en: Tertiary degree (3+ years), level-6 professional qualification, or 5+ years' professional experience (IT: 3 of the last 7 years)

requirements.ja: 6か月以上の雇用契約・オファー
requirements.en: Job offer or contract of at least 6 months

requirements.ja: ISTATの被用者平均年間総賃金以上の給与（約€36,300）
requirements.en: Salary at least the ISTAT average annual gross wage per employee (approx. €36,300)

salaryThreshold.note: Approximate figure ("circa") given by the official portal in March 2024, pegged to the ISTAT average gross annual wage per employee. It is updated with ISTAT data, so verify the current amount.

source.title: Integrazione Migranti (Ministero del Lavoro) – Cos'è e come si richiede la carta blu Ue

name.ja: フッシ令（年間受入枠）

summary.ja: 政府が定める年間受入枠の範囲で、雇用主が指定日（クリックデー）にオンラインで就労許可（nulla osta）を申請する制度。2026〜2028年の3年間で計497,550人の受入れを予定。
summary.en: Quota-based system: employers apply online on set 'click days' for a work authorisation (nulla osta) within government quotas. A total of 497,550 third-country entries is planned for 2026–2028.

requirements.ja: イタリアの雇用主による申請（ALIポータル）
requirements.en: Italian employer files the request via the Interior Ministry's ALI portal

requirements.ja: 受入枠の範囲内であること（一部枠は移民協力協定締結国の国民向け）
requirements.en: A place within the quota; some quotas are reserved for nationals of countries with migration cooperation agreements

processingNote.ja: 2026年の非季節労働の申請受付は2月16日（協定国）・2月18日（その他）から。
processingNote.en: 2026 click days for non-seasonal employment: 16 Feb (agreement countries) and 18 Feb (others).

source.title: Ministero del Lavoro – Flussi 2026-2028, pubblicato il decreto

name.ja: 技能需要ビザ（Skills in Demand、subclass 482）

summary.ja: 豪州の認定スポンサー企業に指名されて最長4年間働く一時就労ビザ。一般的な専門職はCore Skills stream（コアスキル職業リストCSOL掲載職種）、高所得の専門職はSpecialist Skills streamで申請する。
summary.en: Temporary employer-sponsored visa for up to 4 years. Most professionals apply through the Core Skills stream (occupations on the Core Skills Occupation List, CSOL); highly paid specialists can use the Specialist Skills stream.

requirements.ja: 認定スポンサーによる指名（Core Skills streamはCSOL掲載職種）
requirements.en: Nomination by an approved sponsor; for the Core Skills stream, the occupation must be on the CSOL

requirements.ja: 市場賃金（AMSR）以上かつコアスキル所得基準（CSIT）以上の給与
requirements.en: Pay of at least the annual market salary rate (AMSR) and no less than the Core Skills Income Threshold (CSIT)

requirements.ja: 指名職種または関連分野で1年以上の職務経験
requirements.en: At least 1 year of relevant work experience in the nominated occupation or a related field

requirements.ja: 職種により技能評価、所定の英語力（免除あり）
requirements.en: Skills assessment if required for the occupation, and minimum English proficiency unless exempt

salaryThreshold.note: Core Skills Income Threshold (CSIT) for nominations lodged 1 Jul 2026 – 30 Jun 2027 (AUD 76,515 for 2025–26). Specialist Skills stream threshold (SSIT) is AUD 146,576. Pay must also meet the market salary rate. Indexed every 1 July (see Home Affairs 'Salary requirements to nominate a worker').

processingNote.ja: 在留は最長4年（香港旅券保持者は5年）。要件を満たせば永住申請（186等）が可能。所得基準は毎年7月1日に改定。
processingNote.en: Stay of up to 4 years (5 for Hong Kong passport holders), with a pathway to permanent residence (e.g. subclass 186) if eligible. Income thresholds are indexed every 1 July.

source.title: Department of Home Affairs – Skills in Demand visa (subclass 482) Core Skills stream

name.ja: 雇用主指名永住ビザ（Employer Nomination Scheme、subclass 186）

summary.ja: 豪州の雇用主の指名に基づく永住ビザ。Direct Entry streamでは海外から直接申請でき、482保持者はTemporary Residence Transition streamで移行できる。
summary.en: Permanent visa based on nomination by an Australian employer. The Direct Entry stream allows direct applications, and 482 holders can move over through the Temporary Residence Transition stream.

requirements.ja: 雇用主による指名（CSOL掲載職種）
requirements.en: Employer nomination for an occupation on the Core Skills Occupation List

requirements.ja: 申請時45歳未満（免除あり）
requirements.en: Under 45 at the time of application, unless exempt

requirements.ja: 原則3年以上の関連職務経験と事前の技能評価（Direct Entry stream）
requirements.en: At least 3 years of relevant work experience and a positive skills assessment before applying (Direct Entry stream), unless exempt

requirements.ja: 所定の英語力、健康・人物要件
requirements.en: Minimum English proficiency, plus health and character requirements

requirements.ja: 市場賃金以上かつCSIT以上の給与
requirements.en: Salary of at least the market rate and the Core Skills Income Threshold (CSIT)

salaryThreshold.note: CSIT applies to ENS nominations lodged on or after 7 Dec 2024; AUD 79,423 for nominations lodged 1 Jul 2026 – 30 Jun 2027 (source: Home Affairs 'Salary requirements to nominate a worker').

processingNote.ja: 永住ビザ（無期限）。
processingNote.en: Permanent visa.

source.title: Department of Home Affairs – Employer Nomination Scheme (subclass 186) Direct Entry stream

name.ja: 独立技能移民ビザ（Skilled Independent、subclass 189）

summary.ja: 雇用主や州のスポンサー不要のポイント制永住ビザ。SkillSelectで関心表明（EOI）を提出し、招待を受けて申請する。
summary.en: Points-tested permanent visa that needs no employer or state sponsor. Applicants submit an Expression of Interest (EOI) in SkillSelect and must be invited to apply.

requirements.ja: 対象の技能職業リスト掲載職種と適切な技能評価
requirements.en: Occupation on the relevant skilled occupation list, with a suitable skills assessment

requirements.ja: ポイントテストで65点以上
requirements.en: Score at least 65 points on the points test

requirements.ja: 招待時に45歳未満
requirements.en: Under 45 when invited to apply

requirements.ja: SkillSelectからの招待
requirements.en: Invitation to apply via SkillSelect

processingNote.ja: 65点は最低ライン。実際の招待点数は招待ラウンドごとに職種別に決まり、通常はより高い。
processingNote.en: 65 points is only the minimum; the scores actually invited are set per invitation round and occupation, and are usually higher.

source.title: Department of Home Affairs – Skilled Independent visa (subclass 189) Points-tested stream

name.ja: ナショナル・イノベーション・ビザ（subclass 858、旧グローバル・タレント）
name.en: National Innovation visa (subclass 858, formerly Global Talent)

summary.ja: 国際的に認められた卓越した実績を持つ研究者・起業家・投資家・アスリート・クリエイター等のための招待制永住ビザ。
summary.en: Invitation-only permanent visa for exceptionally talented people, such as researchers, entrepreneurs, innovative investors, athletes and creatives, with an internationally recognised record of outstanding achievement.

requirements.ja: 関心表明（EOI）を提出して招待を受け、招待から60日以内に申請
requirements.en: Submit an Expression of Interest, be invited, and apply within 60 days of the invitation

requirements.ja: 職業・スポーツ・芸術・学術研究のいずれかで国際的に認められた卓越した実績
requirements.en: Internationally recognised record of exceptional and outstanding achievement in a profession, sport, the arts, or academia and research

requirements.ja: 同分野で全国的評価のある推薦者（豪市民・永住者・適格NZ市民・豪州の団体）
requirements.en: A nominator with a national reputation in the same field (Australian citizen, permanent resident, eligible NZ citizen or Australian organisation)

processingNote.ja: 給与基準はなし。招待は政府の優先分野に基づいて行われる。
processingNote.en: No salary threshold; invitations are issued in line with the government's National Innovation visa priorities.

source.title: Department of Home Affairs – National Innovation visa (subclass 858)

name.ja: エンプロイメント・パス（EP）

summary.ja: 専門職・管理職・役員向けの就労パス。年齢別の最低給与（Stage 1）を満たし、原則としてポイント制のCOMPASS（Stage 2）で40点以上が必要。
summary.en: Work pass for professionals, managers and executives. Candidates must earn at least the age-graded qualifying salary (Stage 1) and, unless exempt, score 40 points on the points-based COMPASS framework (Stage 2).

requirements.ja: シンガポールの雇用主からの雇用オファー（事前にMyCareersFutureで求人掲載が必要）
requirements.en: Job offer from a Singapore employer, which must first advertise the role on MyCareersFuture (Fair Consideration Framework)

requirements.ja: 月額固定給S$5,600以上（年齢とともに上昇し45歳以上はS$10,700、金融はS$6,200〜S$11,800）
requirements.en: Fixed monthly salary of at least S$5,600, rising with age to S$10,700 at 45+ (financial services: S$6,200 to S$11,800)

requirements.ja: COMPASSで40点以上（給与・学歴・多様性・現地雇用支援等。月額S$22,500以上などは免除）
requirements.en: 40 points on COMPASS (salary, qualifications, diversity, support for local employment, plus bonuses); exempt if the fixed monthly salary is S$22,500+ or in other listed cases

salaryThreshold.note: S$5,600/month × 12, the current minimum for the youngest applicants (all sectors except financial services, where it is S$6,200/month). It rises progressively with age from 23, up to S$10,700/month at 45+. From 1 Jan 2027 (new applications), the minimum rises to S$6,000/month (S$6,600 in financial services).

processingNote.ja: 不足スキルを持つ経験豊富なテック人材は5年間のEPを申請可能。最低給与は2027年1月1日の新規申請から引き上げ。
processingNote.en: Experienced tech professionals with skills in shortage may apply for a 5-year EP. Qualifying salaries rise for new applications from 1 Jan 2027.

source.title: Ministry of Manpower – Eligibility for Employment Pass

name.ja: Sパス

summary.ja: 中技能の専門職・技術者（准専門職）向けの就労パス。雇用主には外国人雇用枠（クォータ）と外国人雇用税（レビー）が適用される。
summary.en: Work pass for mid-skilled staff (associate professionals and technicians). Employers are subject to a quota and a monthly levy.

requirements.ja: シンガポールでの雇用オファー
requirements.en: Job offer in Singapore

requirements.ja: 月額固定給S$3,300以上（年齢とともに上昇し45歳以上はS$4,800、金融はS$3,800〜S$5,650）
requirements.en: Fixed monthly salary of at least S$3,300, rising with age to S$4,800 at 45+ (financial services: S$3,800 to S$5,650)

requirements.ja: 雇用主の外国人雇用枠・レビー
requirements.en: Employer quota and levy apply

salaryThreshold.note: S$3,300/month × 12, the current minimum for the youngest applicants (all sectors except financial services, where it is S$3,800/month). It rises with age up to S$4,800/month at 45+. From 1 Jan 2027 (new applications), the minimum rises to S$3,600/month (S$4,000 in financial services).

processingNote.ja: 最低給与は2027年1月1日の新規申請から引き上げ。
processingNote.en: Qualifying salaries rise for new applications from 1 Jan 2027.

source.title: Ministry of Manpower – Eligibility for S Pass

name.ja: ONEパス（Overseas Networks & Expertise Pass）

summary.ja: ビジネス・芸術・スポーツ・学術・研究のトップ人材向けの個人パス。特定の雇用主に縛られず、複数の会社で同時に働いたり起業したりできる。
summary.en: Personalised pass for top talent in business, the arts, sports, academia and research. Holders are not tied to one employer and may work for several companies or start a business.

requirements.ja: 過去12か月（1社から）または将来のシンガポール雇用主から月額固定給S$30,000以上
requirements.en: Fixed monthly salary of at least S$30,000 from one employer over the previous 12 months, or from a prospective Singapore-based employer

requirements.ja: または芸術・スポーツ・学術研究等での卓越した業績（ケースバイケース審査）
requirements.en: Or outstanding achievements in the arts, sports, science and technology, or academia and research (assessed case by case)

salaryThreshold.note: S$30,000/month × 12 in fixed monthly salary, earned from a single employer (current/last employment or a prospective Singapore employer). The outstanding-achievements and AI & Tech categories are assessed on other criteria.

processingNote.ja: 有効期間5年で更新可能。2027年1月からAI・テック人材向けのONE Pass（AI and Tech）トラックが導入予定（Tech.Passの後継）。
processingNote.en: Valid for 5 years and renewable. A ONE Pass (AI and Tech) track is being introduced from January 2027 to replace the Tech.Pass.

source.title: Ministry of Manpower – Eligibility for Overseas Networks & Expertise Pass

name.ja: テック・パス（Tech.Pass、2027年1月で受付終了）

summary.ja: 実績のあるテック分野の起業家・リーダー・技術専門家向けの個人パス。2027年1月28日以降は新規・更新申請を受け付けず、ONE Pass（AI and Tech）トラックに置き換えられる。
summary.en: Personalised pass for established tech entrepreneurs, leaders and technical experts. New and renewal applications will not be accepted from 28 Jan 2027, when it is replaced by the ONE Pass (AI and Tech) track.

requirements.ja: 直近1年の月額固定給S$22,500以上
requirements.en: Last drawn fixed monthly salary (within the past year) of at least S$22,500

requirements.ja: 評価額US$5億以上または調達額US$3,000万以上のテック企業（またはAUM US$5億以上のVC）で主導的役割5年以上
requirements.en: At least 5 cumulative years in a leading role at a tech company valued at US$500m+ or with US$30m+ funding raised, or at a tech VC firm with US$500m+ AUM

salaryThreshold.note: S$22,500/month × 12 (last drawn fixed monthly salary). Applications close at 23:59 on 27 Jan 2027.

processingNote.ja: 有効期間2年（要件を満たせば2年更新）。既存保持者は期限まで有効。
processingNote.en: Valid for 2 years, renewable once for 2 more if the renewal criteria are met. Existing holders keep their pass until it expires.

source.title: Singapore EDB – Tech.Pass

freeMovement.ja: EU/EEA加盟国およびスイスの市民は就労許可・滞在許可なしにオランダで働ける（EU域内の移動の自由）。
freeMovement.en: EU/EEA and Swiss citizens can work in the Netherlands without a work or residence permit under EU free movement.

name.ja: 高度技能移民（kennismigrant）

summary.ja: IND認定スポンサー企業に雇用される人向けの滞在許可。学位要件はなく、年齢等に応じた給与基準を満たせばよい。
summary.en: Residence permit for employees of an IND-recognised sponsor. There is no degree requirement; the main test is an age-dependent salary threshold.

requirements.ja: IND認定スポンサー（公開登録簿に掲載）との雇用契約
requirements.en: Employment contract with an employer or research institution that is an IND-recognised sponsor (listed in the public register)

requirements.ja: 2026年の月額総給与（休暇手当除く）: 30歳以上€5,942、30歳未満€4,357、新卒等の軽減基準€3,122
requirements.en: 2026 gross monthly salary, excluding holiday allowance: €5,942 at age 30+, €4,357 under 30, or €3,122 under the reduced criterion for recent graduates

requirements.ja: 給与が市場水準に見合うこと
requirements.en: Salary in line with the market rate for the job

salaryThreshold.note: 2026 threshold for age 30+: €5,942 gross/month × 12, excluding the 8% holiday allowance. Under 30: €4,357/month (€52,284/yr). Reduced criterion: €3,122/month (€37,464/yr) during or after an orientation year, or within 3 years of graduating, obtaining a PhD or completing research. Amounts change every 1 January.

processingNote.ja: 認定スポンサー経由の申請は迅速手続き。基準額は毎年1月1日改定。
processingNote.en: Recognised sponsors use an accelerated procedure. Thresholds change every 1 January.

source.title: IND – Required amounts income requirements (2026)

name.ja: EUブルーカード

summary.ja: 高学歴または高度な経験を持つ人向けのEU共通の就労・滞在許可。雇用主は認定スポンサーでなくてもよく、他のEU国への移動や長期滞在許可の取得で有利。
summary.en: EU-wide work and residence permit for highly educated or highly experienced workers. The employer does not have to be a recognised sponsor, and the card makes it easier to move to another EU country or get long-term EU residence.

requirements.ja: 3年以上の高等教育課程の学位（外国学位はNuffic評価）、または学位相当の職務経験5年以上（IT職は直近7年で3年以上）
requirements.en: Higher-education diploma from a programme of at least 3 years (foreign diplomas evaluated by Nuffic), or 5+ years of degree-level experience (IT professionals: 3 years within the last 7)

requirements.ja: 6か月以上の雇用契約
requirements.en: Employment contract of at least 6 months

requirements.ja: 2026年の月額総給与€5,942以上（卒業後3年以内は€4,754）
requirements.en: 2026 gross monthly salary of at least €5,942 (€4,754 within 3 years of graduation)

salaryThreshold.note: 2026 threshold: €5,942 gross/month × 12, excluding holiday allowance. Reduced criterion €4,754/month (€57,048/yr) for graduates who apply within 3 years of graduating (source: IND 'Required amounts income requirements'). Changes every 1 January.

processingNote.ja: ブルーカードで2年経過後、条件によりEU長期滞在許可を申請可能（通常は5年）。
processingNote.en: Blue Card holders can in some cases apply for long-term EU residence after 2 years instead of 5.

source.title: IND – European Blue Card residence permit

name.ja: オリエンテーション・イヤー（zoekjaar hoogopgeleiden）
name.en: Orientation year for highly educated persons (zoekjaar)

summary.ja: オランダまたは世界大学ランキング上位校を卒業した人が、1年間オランダで職探しをするための滞在許可。期間中は就労許可なしで自由に働ける。
summary.en: One-year residence permit to look for work after graduating in the Netherlands or from a top-ranked foreign university. Holders may work freely during the year without a work permit.

requirements.ja: 申請前3年以内に、オランダで学士・修士等を修了、または指定外国大学で修士・博士を取得
requirements.en: Within the 3 years before applying: completed a bachelor's, master's or post-master's programme in the Netherlands, or a master's/PhD at a designated foreign institution

requirements.ja: 指定外国大学 = THE・QS・上海ランキングのうち異なる2つ以上で上位200位以内（総合または分野別）
requirements.en: Designated foreign institution: in the top 200 of at least two rankings from different publishers (Times Higher Education, QS, ShanghaiRanking; general or by subject)

requirements.ja: 収入証明は不要
requirements.en: No proof of income required

processingNote.ja: 期間中または期間後に高度技能移民へ切り替える場合、軽減給与基準（2026年は月€3,122）が適用される。
processingNote.en: Switching to highly skilled migrant during or after the year qualifies for the reduced salary criterion (€3,122/month in 2026).

source.title: IND – Residence permit for orientation year

name.ja: 日蘭通商航海条約・米蘭友好条約（DAFT）による自営業許可
name.en: Self-employment under the Dutch-American Friendship Treaty (DAFT) / Dutch-Japanese Trade Treaty

summary.ja: 米国籍または日本国籍の人が、オランダで自営業・起業をするための滞在許可。通常の自営業許可で求められるポイント審査の代わりに、事業への実質的な投資が要件となる。
summary.en: Residence permit for US or Japanese nationals who want to be self-employed or run a business in the Netherlands. A substantial capital investment in the business replaces the points assessment used for the regular self-employed permit.

requirements.ja: 米国籍または日本国籍
requirements.en: US or Japanese nationality

requirements.ja: 日蘭・米蘭間の貿易、またはオランダでの事業の立ち上げ・運営（自由業も可、政府・医療分野を除く）
requirements.en: Trade between the Netherlands and the US/Japan, or developing and running a business in the Netherlands (including an independent profession, except in government or healthcare)

requirements.ja: 事業への実質的な資本投資（多くの事業形態で最低€4,500）
requirements.en: Substantial capital invested in the business (minimum €4,500 for most business forms)

requirements.ja: 初回許可から6か月以内に商工会議所登録と投資を完了
requirements.en: For a first permit: register with the Chamber of Commerce and make the investment within 6 months of the decision

processingNote.ja: 日本国籍者も日蘭通商航海条約により同様の要件で申請可能。
processingNote.en: Japanese nationals can apply under the same requirements through the Dutch-Japanese Trade Treaty.

source.title: IND – Residence permit self-employed person

name.ja: 特定活動（E-7-1 専門人材）

summary.ja: 法務部長官が指定する職種（管理職・IT・エンジニア・研究等の専門職）で韓国の機関と契約して働くための就労ビザ。E-7-1は専門人材区分。
summary.en: Work visa for jobs in occupations designated by the Minister of Justice (managers and professionals such as IT, engineering and R&D), under a contract with an organisation in Korea. E-7-1 is the professional category.

requirements.ja: 韓国の機関・企業との雇用契約（法務部指定職種）
requirements.en: Employment contract with an organisation in Korea for a designated occupation

requirements.ja: 職種ごとの学歴・経歴要件
requirements.en: Education and experience requirements set for each occupation

requirements.ja: 2026年の賃金要件: 年3,112万ウォン以上
requirements.en: 2026 wage requirement: at least KRW 31.12 million a year

salaryThreshold.note: E-7-1 wage requirement applied 1 Feb – 31 Dec 2026 (KRW 31.12 million/yr); E-7-2 and E-7-3 KRW 25.89m, E-7-4 KRW 26.00m. Occupations for which the Minister of Justice has set a different standard follow that standard. Announced by the Ministry of Justice on 29 Dec 2025 and revised annually.

processingNote.ja: 就労活動の範囲は許可された職種・勤務先に限られる。E-9（非専門就業）は単純労働向けで専門職の対象外。
processingNote.en: Work is limited to the approved occupation and employer. E-9 (non-professional employment) is for low-skilled work and does not apply to professionals.

source.title: 법무부 공고 제2025-406호「2026년 특정활동(E-7) 체류자격 임금요건 기준 공고」

summary.ja: 専門職（E-1〜E-7）分野での就職を目指して韓国で求職活動・インターンをするための在留資格。一般求職（D-10-1）はポイント制で審査される。
summary.en: Status for job-seeking and internships in Korea aimed at professional roles (E-1 to E-7 fields). General job seekers (D-10-1) are assessed on a points system.

requirements.ja: E-1〜E-7該当分野での求職目的
requirements.en: Intention to seek work in a field covered by E-1 to E-7

requirements.ja: ポイント制の基準点を満たすこと（一般求職D-10-1）
requirements.en: Meet the points-system pass mark (general job seeker, D-10-1)

requirements.ja: 29歳以下で世界大学ランキング200位以内の大学卒業者等はポイント制・財政要件が免除（2025年10月〜、試行）
requirements.en: Graduates aged 29 or under from universities ranked in the global top 200, among others, are exempt from the points and financial requirements (pilot from Oct 2025)

processingNote.ja: 2025年10月29日から、求職期間は1回1年・最長3年に拡大（従来は1回6か月・最長2年）。同一企業でのインターンは最長1年。
processingNote.en: From 29 Oct 2025, the job-seeking period is up to 1 year per grant and 3 years in total (previously 6 months and 2 years). An internship with a single company can last up to 1 year.

source.title: 법무부 보도자료「법무부, 기업이 원하는 인재 확보를 지원한다」(2025.10.27)

name.ja: 居住（F-2-7 点数制優秀人材）

summary.ja: 専門職等で一定期間在留した人や高所得の有望産業従事者等がポイント制の基準を満たすと取得できる長期居住資格。就労制限がほぼなく、永住（F-5）への足がかりになる。
summary.en: Long-term residence status for professionals already in Korea (and some other groups) who meet the points criteria. It largely removes job restrictions and is a stepping stone to permanent residence (F-5).

requirements.ja: 対象類型: 上場企業従事者、有望産業従事者（前年所得GNIの1.5倍以上）、専門職従事者（D-5〜D-9・E-1〜E-7-1で3年以上連続在留）、国内修士以上の留学人材など
requirements.en: Eligible groups include employees of listed companies, workers in promising industries (prior-year income at least 1.5× GNI per capita), professionals with 3+ consecutive years in D-5 to D-9 or E-1 to E-7-1 status, and graduates with a Korean master's or higher

requirements.ja: ポイント制の基準点、品行・公衆衛生等の要件
requirements.en: Meet the points threshold plus conduct and public-health requirements

requirements.ja: 家族を居住（F-2）で帯同するには本人所得がGNI以上であること
requirements.en: Main applicant's income must be at least GNI per capita to bring family members on F-2

processingNote.ja: 配点・基準点の詳細は法務部の指針で定められ、改定されることがある。申請前にHi Koreaの在留資格別案内マニュアルで確認を。
processingNote.en: Point scores and the pass mark are set in Ministry of Justice guidelines and may change; check the current Hi Korea visa manual before applying.

source.title: 법무부 출입국·외국인정책본부「비자 내비게이터」(2022.12)
